$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 8): engine-acceptable-decision-types is the locked list of decisions the engine may accept without a person's card: lowest-tier intake, and a change authorization for a standard change whose model is active.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 7): default-ai-only-code-approval-handling ships as flag. An AI-only code approval never counts as authorization.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9): confirmation-channel sets which act counts as the person's for each kind of AI draft.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12): workload-grant-max-days caps how long a Workload Grant may run before a new decision renews it.
Every setting of document 21, section 3.6 is here exactly once (V38). The read visibility settings follow document 28, issue 10 and Q13.
